summary: fix(settings): show loading state on v2 pairing scan_qr during TOTP
description:
Because:
* On v2 pairing, a 2FA account saw the QR card on scan_qr before
  the redirect to the TOTP page.

This commit:
* Shows the loading state on scan_qr until the TOTP check finishes.
* Hides "Skip for now" while the check is pending.

Closes FXA-14782
